invalid_query: The search filters are not valid.
invalid_amount: The amount must be zero or greater with up to two decimals.
empty_update: There are no changes to save.
not_enabled: This business doesn't use purchase orders. Turn them on in My profile, under business settings.
not_found: The purchase order does not exist.
not_draft: This order is already issued: its lines, supplier and agreed cost can't be edited. Expected date, reference, terms and notes stay open.
not_editable: This order is already closed or canceled: nothing else can be noted.
date_in_future: {field}: the order date can't be after today. The expected delivery date can.
product_not_found: One of the products in the order does not exist.
presentation_invalid: That presentation does not belong to that product or is deactivated.
warehouse_required: You have no assigned warehouse: choose where the order will be received.
needs_lines: Add at least one product before issuing the order.
line_needs_cost: Enter the agreed cost for {field}: it's what the invoice will be matched against.
not_closable: Only an issued order that is still waiting for goods can be closed.
has_draft_receipts: This order has a draft receipt: confirm or cancel it before closing the order.
has_receipts: This order already has goods received: it is closed, not canceled.
not_cancelable: This order can no longer be canceled.
line_not_found: That line does not exist in the order.
cancel_reason_required: Write the reason for the cancellation (at least 3 characters).
draft_has_no_document: A draft order isn't sent yet: issue it first.
not_receivable: Goods can only be received against an issued order that is still waiting for them.
receipt_not_draft: This receipt is already confirmed or canceled: its lines can't be edited.
receipt_needs_lines: Add at least one line before confirming the receipt.
receipt_line_foreign: {field}: that line does not belong to this order.
line_closed_short: {field}: that line was closed short; the supplier will no longer deliver it. If it arrived, reopen the order with a new line.
over_receipt: Line {line}: more than what is pending ({pending}) is arriving. Receive up to the pending amount and note the rest.
receipt_date_in_future: {field}: the receipt date can't be after today. A receipt is a fact.
receipt_invoiced: This receipt is already invoiced in a purchase: cancel that purchase first.
